variables.name: NODE_ENV
variables.description: Node runtime environment.

variables.name: PORT
variables.description: Internal HTTP port for Fastify daemon.

variables.name: HOST
variables.description: Network interface binding for container/host listener.

variables.name: DATABASE_URL
variables.storageLocation: Owner-managed KMS / Hosting Secret Vault (never committed to Git or logged)
variables.description: PostgreSQL connection string with Supavisor transaction pooler on port 6543 and strict SSL mode.

variables.name: DATABASE_POOL_MIN
variables.description: Minimum idle connection pool size per container instance.

variables.name: DATABASE_POOL_MAX
variables.description: Maximum connection pool size per container instance.

variables.name: DATABASE_STATEMENT_TIMEOUT_MS
variables.description: PostgreSQL statement timeout preventing rogue query starvation (10 seconds).

variables.name: SUPABASE_URL
variables.description: Supabase API origin.

variables.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
variables.storageLocation: Owner-managed KMS / Hosting Secret Vault (never committed to Git or logged)
variables.description: Privileged Supabase service-role token for account provisioning, RLS bypass on system maintenance, and auth webhooks.

variables.name: SUPABASE_JWT_SECRET
variables.description: HMAC secret or private key corresponding to auth tokens issued by Supabase GoTrue.

variables.name: SUPABASE_JWKS_URL
variables.description: JWKS endpoint for asymmetric RS256/ES256 public key verification of user JWT bearer tokens.

variables.name: DAYNORI_REAUTHENTICATION_SECRET
variables.description: High-entropy 256-bit secret used by the API to sign short-lived (15-minute) reauthentication and confirmation tokens.

variables.name: DAYNORI_API_ORIGIN
variables.description: Canonical origin of the API service for building canonical callback and attachment links.

variables.name: CORS_ORIGIN
variables.description: Allowed Access-Control-Allow-Origin header for browser cross-origin requests.

variables.name: ALLOWED_ORIGINS
variables.description: Comma-separated list of whitelisted web origins authorized to exchange cookies and credentials.

variables.name: DAYNORI_CORE_PREVIEW
variables.description: Set to false for public production core web release to enforce standard 15-second request timeouts and standard storage adapters.

variables.name: RATE_LIMIT_MAX_PER_MINUTE
variables.description: Fastify rate limit per client IP for general API endpoints.

variables.name: RATE_LIMIT_AUTH_MAX_PER_MINUTE
variables.description: Fastify rate limit per client IP for authentication and recovery endpoints.
